request.text: We are a couple traveling with our five year old son for a relaxed five day break. Please keep every day gentle, with no starts before nine and one full rest afternoon in the middle. We need a building with an elevator and metro friendly routes so we never walk too far with a tired kid. We eat halal and our son cannot eat peanuts, so please favor restaurants that label halal options clearly. Keep the total budget under one thousand three hundred dollars, avoid long walks between stops, and also include a morning at the Jean Talon market and an afternoon at the science centre please.
